summary: evidence-flip-ready judges an unlogged pass by the published log: explained when a log head at most 240 s after the run was created lists the record (CI publishes its records minutes after observing them, and a gate can read the head one pull late); without a readable log it falls back to observed_at, and a field printed as None names no time

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. The report gains log_clock.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; the gate's decisions do not change, only how the flip trigger counts unlogged passes.

compatibility.detail: Read only, as before; it now also fetches the published log head history (shallow, about 6 MB a day) into its cache directory.

recovery.detail: Its cache directory can be removed at any time.
